current_subpart: Weight Range and Center of Gravity

amendments.subpart_at_time: Weight Range and Center of Gravity
amendments.text:
If the center of gravity position under any possible loading

condition between the maximum weight as specified in § 3.74 and the minimum weight as specified in § 3.75 lies beyond (a) the extremes selected by the applicant, or (b) the extremes for which the structure has been proven, or (c) the extremes for which compliance with all functional requirements were demonstrated, loading instructions shall be provided in the Airplane Flight Manual as specified in § 3.777-3.780. PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS GENERAL
